title: Qt: Add context menu to Resolved Addresses
description:
Create a derived class for the TableViews to make it easier
to create the context menus.
Enable copying and saving only selected rows

Add release notes

Related to #16419

notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • 369651d6 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • e66f010c - Qt: Add context menu to Resolved Addresses
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13539/diffs?diff_id=862078229&start_sha=ab69fe43f215c368496aff68da6d7c03f82916dc)
isRowSelected() changed behavior in 5.15 and started include empty model index, but we still support older Qt. fix in !13555

Ah, thanks.

> "Since Qt 5.15, the default argument for parent is an empty model index."

+private:

+    AStringListListModel* dataModel() const;
+    void copyToClipboard(eResolvedAddressesExport format, bool selected);

+private slots:
+    void clipboardAction();
